## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->
This repository is a curated, automatically labeled list of GitHub projects that have been tagged with the `agent-skills` topic. It aggregates repositories into categories such as skills & collections, integrations & managers, and provides label legends to indicate compliance, security signals, and other metadata. The list is kept up‑to‑date automatically, showing counts, last update date, and a summary table to help users discover relevant agent skill repositories. Developers, researchers, and AI‑tool builders can use this collection to find ready‑made skills, integrations, or examples for building or extending their own agents. To get started, simply browse the README or follow the links to the individual repositories of interest.
